artworks.title: Jean Fronteau
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man in a three-quarter view. He has a mustache, short hair, and is wearing formal historical attire with a high collar. A dark drape is visible over his shoulder. The portrait is within an ornate oval frame with inscriptions. The background has a light, hatched pattern. Below the portrait, a rectangular label contains text.

artworks.title: Nicolas Fouquet
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of a man facing the right. He has a long, prominent nose, high cheekbones, a slight smile, and visible eyes. The man has long, wavy hair, wears a small cap, and a dark robe with a white collar. There is a decorative tassel near his neck. The background features an intricately designed oval frame with a lined pattern. Below the portrait, there are decorative elements including ribbons and a coat of arms with text inscribed on either side.

artworks.title: Basile Fouquet
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body, including the head and shoulders. The person is slightly turned to the left, with their face looking at the viewer. They have wavy, shoulder-length hair, a long nose, full lips, and a subtle smile. The person is dressed in formal attire with a dark, richly-textured garment, a star-shaped decoration, and a wide collar underlay. They are also wearing a sash across their chest. The background has an ornate, oval frame with decorative lines radiating outward. Inside the frame at the bottom is an emblem or crest featuring a lion.

artworks.title: Gaspard de Fieubet
artworks.description: An engraved portrait featuring the upper body of a man with long hair, a mustache, prominent cheekbones, and a slightly pointed chin. He is positioned slightly angled to the left with a direct gaze. The man wears a historical formal garment with a large collar and fur stripes. The oval frame around the portrait has inscriptions, and below it is an ornate crest with decorative elements and a shield with symbols. The background comprises fine lines typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Hippolyte Feret
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man seated and facing slightly towards the viewer's right. He has a prominent nose, calm expression, and wears a cap with some hair visible. The man is adorned in a high-collared garment with a gathered front design. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the portrait. The background features an oval frame with an inscription and the portrait is rendered in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Charles Faure
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body, focusing on his head and shoulders. He is positioned in a slightly turned manner, gazing out towards the viewer from the side. The man has a full face with a defined nose, a slight smile, short, neat hair, and a short beard. He wears detailed, possibly clerical clothing with fine lines and a high collar. The background features an oval frame with a dense pattern of lines, enclosed within a rectangular border with a text plaque at the bottom.

artworks.title: John Evelyn
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with a long face, a prominent nose, full lips, and long, wavy hair cascading down to their shoulders. The person is wearing a cloak or shawl fastened with a row of large beads or pearls, over a high-collared shirt with a checked or patterned cravat. The background features an ornate oval frame encircling the person's upper half, against a crosshatched design. Below the portrait is a decorative element featuring books and an inscribed ribbon, with text in Latin and Greek.

artworks.title: Cardinal d'Estrees
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man's upper body. He is turned slightly to the side with his head facing the viewer. The man has wavy, shoulder-length hair and a faint mustache. He is wearing a high-collared shirt beneath a dark cloak and has a cross pendant around his neck. The background features an oval frame with engraved text and a detailed coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Bernard, Duc d'Epernon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person facing slightly to the viewer's right. The individual has curly, shoulder-length hair and defined facial features, including a mustache. They are dressed in period clothing with a white lace collar and armor. Over their shoulder is a cape or shawl with textured fabric. A decorative element resembling a crest or coat of arms is displayed below the portrait. The portrait is set within an oval frame against a plain, patterned background.

artworks.title: Jules, Duc d'Enghien
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Pierre Mignard I
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a person's upper body, including the head, shoulders, and part of the torso. The person faces slightly to the right with long curly hair, a high forehead, prominent eyebrows, and full lips. They wear ornate armor and a draped cloth over it. The engraving is in an oval frame with inscriptions and a fleur-de-lis emblem at the bottom.

artworks.title: Pierre and Jacques Dupuy
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing two men in an upper body shot, positioned side by side within separate oval frames. Both men are facing slightly towards the center with their bodies turned towards the viewer. On the left, the man has a long face with high cheekbones, narrow eyes, and thin lips. His hair is gray and worn short under a skullcap. He is wearing a dark garment with a wide white collar. The man on the right also has a long face, narrow eyes, and a gentle smile. He too wears his graying hair short and has a skullcap. His attire is similarly a dark garment with a prominent wide white collar. Below the two portraits, there is an ornate coat of arms featuring two creatures on either side of a shield. The background consists of a simple lined pattern that creates a contrast with the detailed focus on the faces. The frame holding the engraving provides an additional decorative border.

artworks.title: Pierre Dupuy
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in a high-collared garment, a skullcap and a white collar. He has high cheekbones, a long nose, furrowed brow, thinning hair, and is looking slightly to his right. The oval-framed portrait includes text stating "PETRVS PVTEANVS CL. FIL." The background has thin, parallel lines for texture.

artworks.title: Marquis de Louvois
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's head and shoulders, facing slightly left and looking at the viewer. The person has thick, curly hair flowing down to their shoulders, framing their face. Their facial features include a prominent nose and slightly pursed lips, with a calm expression. They wear a formal garment with a lace collar and a tassel. The background features an oval frame with surrounding text.

artworks.title: Louis, Dauphin de France
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person showing the upper torso and head. The individual is positioned in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the left. They have curly, voluminous hair that flows down past their shoulders. Their facial features are soft with a youthful appearance, and they possess a smooth complexion. The person is wearing an elaborate lace collar with intricate detailing and a fabric drape beneath it. Around the collar, a metallic, ornate armor piece is visible on the shoulder. The background is a simple, rounded frame with inscriptions.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 51.5 x 42.6 cm (20 1/4 x 16 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of an individual shown from the waist up, facing forward with a slight turn to the side. The person has a prominent nose, full lips, and eyes looking directly at the viewer. They have long, curly hair flowing down past the shoulders. The individual wears a detailed garment with ornate embroidery, a high lace collar, and metallic shoulder armor on the right side. The person is not holding any objects or wearing jewelry. The background features a decorative oval frame with a repeated pattern of fleur-de-lis.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the chest up. The individual is slightly turned to their left, looking at the viewer. They have distinct facial features, including a long shape, a high forehead, and a defined chin. The person has curly, shoulder-length hair and wears a lace cravat. They are dressed in armor with decorative elements like the fleur-de-lis motif. The background is an oval frame with an engraved border, including additional fleur-de-lis symbols and inscriptions.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 44.9 x 37.9 cm (17 11/16 x 14 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a man. He is facing slightly left with a calm expression, featuring prominent eyes, a straight nose, and a mustache. His hair is long, curly, and dark, covering his shoulder. He wears a detailed armor piece with metal studs on the shoulder and a lace cravat around his neck. The portrait is in an oval-shaped frame with inscriptions, and there are four sun-like faces in the background at the corners, radiating lines.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 49.5 x 42.1 cm (19 1/2 x 16 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in regal attire with long curly hair. He has strong facial features including arched brows, a Roman nose, full lips, and clear skin. The man is dressed in detailed armor with a high lace collar, a sash, and a ribbon-like accessory at his neck. The background features an oval frame with fleur-de-lis symbols in the corners and Latin text.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 49.6 x 42.2 cm (19 1/2 x 16 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a three-quarter length portrait of a man shown from the chest up. He is positioned at a slight angle, looking towards the viewer with a composed expression. His facial features include a long and narrow face, a prominent aquiline nose, and full lips. His hair is dark, voluminous, and curly, cascading down past his shoulders. He wears a richly detailed garment that includes ornate lace around the collar, intricate patterned fabric beneath, and an armored shoulder piece adorned with metallic detailing. There is no visible jewelry on his person. The background features an oval frame with inscriptions, and decorative symbols are visible at the corners.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.description: The image features a person in a portrait from the waist up within an oval frame. The person is turned slightly to the right, facing forward with a solemn expression. They have a long, narrow face, a pointed nose, and slightly downturned lips. The person's long, curly hair falls past their shoulders. They are wearing period clothing with a high collar and lace detailing, and have a piece of armor over their shoulder. The individual is holding an embroidered fabric. The portrait is surrounded by a decorative border with engraved text and an emblem with crowned insignia below. The background has finely etched lines for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a formal portrait. He is looking directly at the viewer while turned slightly to his right. He has long, curly hair and symmetrical facial features, including a prominent nose and full lips. He is wearing a patterned cloak with fur trim, a large collar, and a star-shaped pendant around his neck. The background features an oval frame with Latin inscription and a decorative, engraved plate below the portrait.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 38.5 x 45.1 cm (15 3/16 x 17 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a detailed bust portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man is facing slightly right, showing his upper torso with features like a prominent nose, full lips, and stoic eyes. He has long, curly, dark hair falling past his shoulders and is dressed in formal attire with a high-collared shirt, cravat, and shoulder armor. The background includes ornamental elements like olive branches, scales, draped fabric, and Latin inscriptions on banners. A decorative crown is depicted above the oval frame, enhancing his regal appearance. The overall composition emphasizes grandeur and formality through intricate engravings in a monochromatic color scheme.

artworks.title: Francois Lotin
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body from the chest up. He is slightly turned to his right, with facial features including a mustache and slight goatee. The man has medium-length hair falling in waves down to his shoulders, and is wearing a formal, dark-colored garment with a white collar and vertical striped patterns on the sleeves. Surrounding him is an ornate oval frame with decorative or inscriptional elements. The background has a patterned texture contrasting with the fine lines of the clothing and frame.

artworks.title: Charles V, Duc de Lorraine
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a historical figure depicted from the mid-chest upwards. The figure is facing slightly to the right with their head turned towards the viewer. They have distinct facial features such as sharp eyebrows and a straight nose, with shoulder-length wavy hair framing their face. The person is wearing an ornate outfit with decorative armor and a large lace collar draped over their shoulders. There are no visible objects or jewelry in their hands. The background is a solid dark color, and the portrayal is surrounded by an oval border containing identifying text. Below the oval frame, there is a detailed crest with floral elements and a crown.
